# Input: `jl-input`

A single-line text field that takes part in forms.

- Class `JlInput`, an atom: `import { JlInput } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/input

A text field that takes part in forms like a native one: give it a name and its value is in the form's
data, required stops the submission, a reset brings back the value written in the HTML, and Enter in it submits the
form, as from a native field (enter fires first).

Pair it with jl-field for a visible label, a hint and an error. Its value is a Jadis change handler: read it with
value.get(), write it with value.set().

## Use

```ts
import { JlInput } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlInput clearable icon="search" placeholder="Search projects" />
```

```html
<jl-input clearable icon="search" placeholder="Search projects"></jl-input>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `''`. The text.
- `type` (attribute `type`): `InputType`, default `'text'`. The kind of text, as a native input.
- `placeholder` (attribute `placeholder`): `string`, default `''`. Shown while empty.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon at the start.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height.
- `clearable` (attribute `clearable`): `boolean`, default `false`. A button empties the field while it holds text.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.
- `readonly` (attribute `readonly`): `boolean`, default `false`. Can be read and copied, not changed.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted while it is empty.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. Drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the field.
- `autocomplete` (attribute `autocomplete`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.
- `inputmode` (attribute `inputmode`): `string`, default `''`. The keyboard a phone shows: numeric for codes, decimal for prices and amounts, tel, email, url, search. As a native input; the type already picks one for email, tel and url.
- `min` (attribute `min`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.
- `step` (attribute `step`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.
- `minlength` (attribute `minlength`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.
- `maxlength` (attribute `maxlength`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.
- `pattern` (attribute `pattern`): `string`, default `''`. As a native input.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `input` (`onInput` in JSX), detail `string`: Each change as people type.
- `enter` (`onEnter` in JSX), detail `string`: Enter was pressed in the field: to pick a first result; in a form, the form then submits.
- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `string`: The value was committed: Enter, leaving the field, or the clear button.

## Slots

- `start`: Before the text: a prefix, an icon.
- `end`: After the text: a unit, a button.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the native field.
- `select(): void`: Selects the whole text.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether the value meets its constraints (required, pattern…).
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the field.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Kinds

A password field gets a button to show what was typed.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-input placeholder="Your name"></jl-input>
  <jl-input type="email" icon="mail" placeholder="you@example.com"></jl-input>
  <jl-input type="password" value="hunter2" placeholder="Password"></jl-input>
</div>
```

### Sizes

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-input size="sm" placeholder="Small"></jl-input>
  <jl-input placeholder="Medium"></jl-input>
  <jl-input size="lg" placeholder="Large"></jl-input>
</div>
```

### Adornments and clear button

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-input value="https://" clearable placeholder="Website">
    <jl-icon slot="start" name="globe"></jl-icon>
  </jl-input>
  <jl-input type="number" value="72" placeholder="Weight">
    <span slot="end">kg</span>
  </jl-input>
</div>
```

### States

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-input label="Read only" value="Read only" readonly></jl-input>
  <jl-input label="Disabled" value="Disabled" disabled></jl-input>
  <jl-input label="Email" value="not-an-email" invalid></jl-input>
</div>
```

### Listening

The value follows the typing; the paragraph listens to input.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-input class="demo-live" placeholder="Type something" clearable></jl-input>
  <p class="muted demo-out">Nothing typed yet.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const input = root.querySelector('.demo-live');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-out');
input.events.register('input', (value) => {
  out.textContent = value === '' ? 'Nothing typed yet.' : `${value.length} characters`;
});
```
